SELECT AS "period",
SUM(CASE WHEN c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS "cnt"
SUM(CASE WHEN c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "cnt"
SUM(CASE WHEN c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "cnt"
FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ORDER BY "period"

SELECT AS "period",
SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_COSTS, 0) - NVL(a.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.TOTAL_COSTS, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0)) AS "amount",
SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0) - NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.RCPTS_NUM, 0)) SUM(NVL(a.REFUND_NUM, 0)) AS "receipt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_ACCT_MASTER a WHERE a.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ORDER BY "period"

SELECT r.STAT_DATE AS "statDate", r.RCPT_NO AS "rcptNo", r.PATIENT_ID AS "patientId", r.VISIT_DATE AS "visitDate", r.TOTAL_CHARGES AS "totalCharges", r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO AS "refundedRcptNo", r.OPERATOR_NO AS "operatorNo", r.BILL_CLASS AS "billClass", r.CREATE_TIME AS "createTime", r.UPDATE_TIME AS "updateTime" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0
AND r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0
ORDER BY r.PATIENT_ID, r.STAT_DATE, r.RCPT_NO

SELECT c.PATIENT_ID AS "patientId", c.VISIT_DATE AS "visitDate", c.RETURNED_DATE AS "returnedDate", c.REGIST_FEE AS "registFee", c.CLINIC_FEE AS "clinicFee", c.CLINIC_LABEL AS "clinicLabel", c.VISIT_TIME_DESC AS "visitTimeDesc", c.OPERATOR_NO AS "operatorNo", c.CREATE_TIME AS "createTime", c.UPDATE_TIME AS "updateTime" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY c.VISIT_DATE

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS "name", SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0
AND r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0
GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS "name", SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 THEN NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) ELSE -NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) END) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0
AND r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0
GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS "name", SUM(CASE WHEN c.RETURNED_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_MOP_QUEUE q ON q.SCHEDULE_ID = c.CLINIC_LABEL || '|' || TO_CHAR(c.VISIT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') || '|' || c.VISIT_TIME_DESC AND q.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID WHERE q.QUEUE_TYPE = 'reserve' AND q.IS_USED = 'used' AND c.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.RETURNED_DATE IS NULL
AND c.RETURNED_DATE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT p.MONEY_TYPE AS "name", COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(rc.PATIENT_ID,'-') || '|' || NVL(p.RCPT_NO,'-')) AS "cnt" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_PAYMENTS_MONEY p JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT rc ON rc.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE rc.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0) > 0
AND NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0) > 0
GROUP BY p.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT p.MONEY_TYPE AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)-NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_PAYMENTS_MONEY p JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT rc ON rc.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE rc.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY p.MONEY_TYPE ORDER BY "amount" DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN p.MONEY_TYPE IN ('医改统筹','医院垫支') THEN '应收账款' WHEN p.MONEY_TYPE IN ('支付宝','现金','信用卡','银行卡','微信','自助POS','支票') THEN '实收金额' ELSE '其他' END AS "name",
NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)-NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)),0) NVL(SUM(NVL(p.REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)),0) AS "amount" FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_PAYMENTS_MONEY p JOIN TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT rc ON rc.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE rc.VISIT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.MONEY_TYPE IN ('医改统筹','医院垫支') THEN '应收账款' WHEN p.MONEY_TYPE IN ('支付宝','现金','信用卡','银行卡','微信','自助POS','支票') THEN '实收金额' ELSE '其他' END ORDER BY "amount" DESC
